name: craft-workflow
description: Spec-driven, cost-routed engineering workflow for any backend stack (Django, FastAPI, Go, Java, Node, PHP: Laravel, Symfony): three routes by size, a hook-enforced spec gate approved once and bound by hash, gates derived from the spec, a concurrency readiness gate, and a Claude Code mod with the status at the top, a craft board, and cost per agent.

status.title: Where the craft status shows
status.description: top: the header of the craft board, docked at the top right of a wide fullscreen terminal, and the band above the prompt when the board has no room. prompt: the band above the prompt only. both: both.

auto_check.title: Run test commands through craft-check
auto_check.description: Rewrites a test command Claude runs (pytest, go test, mvn test, npm test, ...) to go through bin/craft-check, so Gate A records it. Off by default: a permission rule written for the bare command no longer matches the rewritten one.

gate_question.title: Ask instead of refusing at the spec gate
gate_question.description: When Claude tries to write code before the spec is approved, ask the developer: open the spec, approve it, or keep it blocked.

theme.title: Status line and board theme
theme.description: The craft theme for the status line and the board. none: change nothing. The /craft-theme picker writes the same file; the latest change from either place wins.

bar.title: Status line bar style
bar.description: The usage bar style. default: change nothing (the theme's own bar). Saved to the same file as the theme.
